historic_survey.note: The Sunhouse Complex, a Third Bay Tradition condominium complex in the Western Addition designed by Zoe Works in 1979 on passive solar principles and completed in 1980. An underground rock bed gave it thermal mass, absorbing heat by day and radiating it back through the building at night.

historical_record.description: The Redevelopment Agency photographed the property, then the Western Addition Solar House.
